Engine / Source / ThirdParty / Licenses

License-text and inventory store for every third-party dependency vendored under /Engine/Source/ThirdParty/. The master list lives in INVENTORY.html with one row per dependency (name, version, source URL, license type, license-file path, intended use). The full upstream license text for each dependency lands as <Name>.txt in this directory when the dependency is actually integrated. XAutomationTool's release pipeline aggregates these into a shipped NOTICES.html bundle attached to every signed build.
